name: Listening
when: Taking voice input or a long paste

variants.name: Sound in
variants.desc: Sound waves roll in from the side and it pulses along.

variants.name: Lean in
variants.desc: Tilts an ear toward you with its eyes half closed.

variants.name: Mic
variants.desc: A mic sits in front, picking up rings of sound.
